gate3.note: No new core filter was added; broad-market sleeve remains default-off paper only.

hypothesis: Already-selected broad-market leadership paper candidates whose 20-day gain is dominated by one large positive day may represent high-information acceleration leadership and deserve bounded paper notional support.
interpretation: The field gives a distinct read on acceleration concentration, but the best no-regression variant is far below the hard EV lift needed for this crowded broad-market paper-notional family. No shared adapter is changed.

llm_metrics.reason: This run avoids sparse LLM soft-ranking and does not alter LLM prompts or decisions.

next_evidence_needed: Do not retry nearby max-positive-day-share thresholds on the frozen broad-market sample without new forward paper outcomes or a distinct free-data candidate-pool source.

production_impact.promotion_policy: Rejected variants are not promoted. A future positive version would need the same field and scalar implemented in quant/broad_market_paper_sleeve.py with parity tests before retention.

protocol_answers.1_alpha_hypothesis: capital allocation / candidate-pool quality: selected broad-market leaders with a high max_positive_day_share_20 may be acceleration leaders worth extra default-off paper notional.
protocol_answers.2_past_similar_experiments: exp-20260523-006 tested absolute max_daily_return_20 and rejected smooth/non-spike support; exp-20260524-024 tested coarse path clusters but not max_positive_day_share_20; exp-20260527-026 and exp-20260528-001 rejected repeat/freshness support.
protocol_answers.3_single_variable: Only max_positive_day_share_20_min/scalar changes inside one notional-support field; eligibility, rank, sizing stack before the new scalar, hold, slots, and frozen universe stay fixed.
protocol_answers.4_acceptance: Gate 4 requires positive aggregate EV/PnL, all 3 windows EV-positive, no EV/PnL regression windows, >=8 adjusted trades across all 3 windows, concentration guard, <=0.5pp max drawdown worsening, identity replay parity, and >10% relative aggregate EV improvement.
protocol_answers.5_reproducibility: Script, frozen candidate universe, JSON artifact, log, tickets, markdown artifact, and JSONL identify windows, parameters, and metrics.

rejection_reason: Explosive return-path support did not clear Gate 4: stable variants improved all three windows only marginally and failed the >10% relative aggregate EV requirement; aggressive variants introduced window EV regression.
single_causal_variable: max_positive_day_share_20 threshold/scalar for fixed broad-market selected candidates

warehouse_audit.manifest_note: Partial warehouse is acceptable for this paper scout because the candidate set is restricted to all-window full-liquid rows.
